finding: The converged direction is a semantic possibility preprocessor rather than a conventional row-returning database: SQLite remains canonical transactional substrate; coherent semantic generations and ClayGraph current-head projections accelerate bounded access; U10 compiles rebuildable anchor-conditioned possibility fields; the prompt path consumes a bounded projection. A local adversarial test falsified the assumption that high graph reachability/completeness is sufficient for candidate proof: untrusted high-weight edges could promote a wrong affordance. V1.1 repairs this by separating activation propagation from proof propagation.
required_architecture_rule: Every U10/V11 derivation witness and access path must carry or derive a proof-admissibility class from non-model provenance policy. Graph activation/reachability may rank or expose a candidate, but only proof-eligible witness edges may satisfy affordance requirements. MODEL_PROPOSED, stale, provenance-unresolved, or correlation-only paths remain activation-only until independently validated.
preserved_boundaries: ClayGraph and compiled possibility fields are rebuildable derived access products.
source_epoch, graph_epoch and field/generation epoch must be coherent or fail closed.
shared lineage ancestry counts once and is not independent replication.
counterevidence/CONFLICT/UNKNOWN must survive projection and can force abstention.
counterhypotheses: Trusted-but-wrong edges may still poison proof unless proof eligibility is derived from evidence provenance rather than a boolean flag.
The synthetic fixture may overfit the scoring policy and does not establish superiority over dense, late-interaction, graph-RAG, or other database/retrieval systems.
Compiled fields may improve retrieval while harming downstream answer quality through omission/compression bias.
Maintenance, invalidation and witness-rebuild costs may erase hot-read gains at real FRANK scale.
next_gate: Execute held-out real-snapshot benchmark with FTS5/BM25, dense/late-interaction and graph baselines; include null queries, stale/corrupt/trusted-but-wrong edge lesions, provenance spoofing, counterevidence recall, Recall@k/nDCG/MRR, abstention error, p50/p95/p99, rebuild/memory/token cost and downstream answer/task outcome. Execute the new UDB/ClayGraph hotpath benchmark and persist its receipt before performance promotion.
ancestry_policy: All listed repo implementation/benchmark commits from this coordinated development wave share ancestry and are not independent scientific replications.
frank_scope: No Frank v0.1 release or consciousness claim; this is Research-Entity/Clay infrastructure until separately integrated and validated on Ubuntu target scope.
